case: Brevik finite-life forward cash waterfall and issuer bridge

group_rcobd_2025_eur_m.note: Rounded preliminary headline RCOBD; detailed income statement reports EUR4,679.3m. Model consistently uses rounded EUR4,679m.

pension_provisions_2025_eur_m.note: Noncurrent EUR569.3m plus current EUR54.9m: gross book provision proxy, not an appraised pension deficit.

shares_post_january_2026_cancellation.note: Issued shares after cancellation; not FY2025 weighted-average EPS denominator. No later buybacks assumed.

construction_forecast_autumn_2024_nok_m.note: June 2025 publication: NOK2,200m integration plus NOK2,700m capture/compression/intermediate storage. Forecast, not audited final cost or Heidelberg retained capital.

startup_grant_ceiling_nok_m.note: Ceiling conditional on readiness to ship first load; not evidence cash receipt.

group_government_grants_2025_eur_m.note: Consolidated investing cash-flow grant line; cannot allocate to Brevik from this document. Never treat all group grants as Brevik receipts.

equity_accounted_result_2025_eur_m.note: Income statement result from equity-accounted investments enters reported RCOBD; subtract before applying consolidated operating multiple and separately adding JV/associate value proxy.

commercial_plan.note: Production expectations, not observed sales, captured CO2 or invoiced premium tonnes.

assumptions.note: All numerical assumptions in this section are analyst scenarios, except management carbon-price endpoints attributed to HM3. The original ten-year support concept is sourced, but 2034 is an assumed expiry, not a verified amended date. EUR thresholds, remaining aid cap and unit costs are unverified. Carbon price is held flat after 2030. First-year flows are uniformly prorated from cutoff and placed at year-end. Residual capital is future spending, not construction to date. No depreciation tax shield, loss refund, financing, perpetual terminal value, replication or discount-rate reduction.

issuer_bridge.price_status: NEEDS_DATA: no verified exact 25 February 2026 exchange close; no upside-to-spot computed.
issuer_bridge.note: Multiples and book-value proxies are assumptions. Deduct equity-accounted result from reported RCOBD before applying operating multiple; add JV/associate book-value proxy separately, avoiding double-counting. Group operating results include Brevik. Remove central embedded project PV before adding scenario PV; a zero embedded fraction requires an ex-Brevik baseline. Reported net debt is deducted once, without separate cash, lease or debt subtraction. Pension proxy includes current and noncurrent provisions. No early 2026 balance-sheet roll-forward or current-price target.

lifecycle.status: NEEDS_DATA: final gross spend, dated grants, startup-grant receipt, investor retained capital, 2025 operating cash, amended aid terms, tax shields and original investment timing unverified. Capital-recovery sensitivities are not historical lifecycle NPV or IRR.

double_counting_rules: Premium excludes conventional cement revenue and ordinary carbon-price pass-through.
Operating aid is computed from gross eligible capture cost once; never use already-net opex as its base.
ETS savings apply only to eligible stored fossil CO2; non-ETS aid applies only to separate non-ETS tonnes during the support period.
Carbon cash is realized after a specified lag; retained fractions represent free-allocation/monetization/aid adjustment uncertainty, not asserted contract terms.
No assumed startup grant receipt or historical construction subsidy enters future FCF.
Future value subtracts residual capital once; lifecycle capital sensitivities are shown separately, never subtracted twice.
No separate green multiple or lower discount rate is added.
